gallery.title: File:500px photo (166536087).jpeg
gallery.description: 500px provided description: Untitled Google search Ai overview: The prayer plaque collection area at the Meiji Jingu Shrine in Tokyo, Japan. The shrine is dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken. Visitors write their wishes on wooden plaques called "ema" and hang them at the shrine. The Meiji Shrine is open every day from sunrise to sunset and has no admission fee.
